Newly introduced gum disease treatment kills bad bacteria while sparing the good

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1161 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Sciencedaily

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Researchers in Japan have developed a promising fresh treatment for gum disease that kills harmful bacteria while leaving beneficial microbes unharmed.
  • Sources indicate that developed by scientists at Nagoya University, the treatment combines antibodies obtained from egg yolks with near-infrared light.
  • Why Conventional Gum Disease Treatments Can Cause Problems.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Researchers in Japan have developed a promising fresh treatment for gum disease that kills harmful bacteria while leaving beneficial microbes unharmed. Unlike conventional approaches that can eliminate both good and bad bacteria, the new therapy is designed to target specific microbes responsible for damaging gums and the bone that supports teeth.

Sources indicate that developed by scientists at Nagoya University, the treatment combines antibodies obtained from egg yolks with near-infrared light. Early experiments in human cell cultures and mice suggest that it could offer a more precise way to combat periodontitis, a serious form of gum disease that can eventually lead to tooth loss. The findings were published in the Journal of Translational Medicine.

Why Conventional Gum Disease Treatments Can Cause Problems.

Recent findings suggest that the human mouth contains a complex community of microorganisms, many of which play vital roles in maintaining oral health. Problems can arise when harmful bacteria multiply and disturb this delicate balance.

One particularly troublesome species is Porphyromonas gingivalis (P. gingivalis), which scientists classify as a keystone pathogen. This means it can have an outsized influence on the surrounding microbial community, even when it is not especially abundant. By promoting inflammation and disrupting the normal balance of oral bacteria, it can contribute to the destruction of the bone that holds teeth in place.

In a recent development, treating periodontitis often involves eliminating the bacteria responsible for the infection. However, some existing antimicrobial treatments do not distinguish between harmful organisms and microbes that help maintain a healthy mouth.

"Current treatments for periodontitis, including antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT), eliminate both pathogenic and beneficial oral bacteria," said Kazuhide Sato, one of the corresponding authors and a lecturer at Nagoya University. "These approaches often disrupt the entire oral microbial ecosystem and can also release lipopolysaccharide (LPS), an endotoxin that may exacerbate inflammation.".

Scientists Adapt Cancer Therapy to Target Gum Disease Bacteria.

In a recent development, to overcome these limitations, the Nagoya University team turned to a technology originally designed to treat cancer. Known as near-infrared photoimmunotherapy, it uses antibodies linked to a light-sensitive dye to recognize specific targets. Once the compound attaches to its intended target, exposure to near-infrared light activates the dye and produces a damaging effect.

The researchers adapted this strategy to attack P. gingivalis without unnecessarily disturbing other oral bacteria. Their approach relies on IgY, a type of antibody collected from the egg yolks of hens that have been immunized against the pathogen.

It has been revealed that egg yolk antibodies offer a practical advantage because they can be produced in large quantities at relatively low cost. This could make them an attractive option for developing targeted treatments that are affordable and scalable.

The resulting technology, called near-infrared photo-antibacterial targeting therapy (NIR-PAT²), was developed by researchers at Nagoya University Graduate School of Medicine. The team included first author Hiroshi Maruyama, Professor Hideharu Hibi, and corresponding authors Sato and Kiyoshi Sakai.

Recent findings suggest that to determine whether the treatment could destroy harmful bacteria while protecting healthy tissue, the researchers tested it in human cell cultures and mice. They also compared its effects with those of conventional antimicrobial therapies.

Light-Activated Antibodies Destroy Harmful Bacteria.

Laboratory experiments indicated that the antibody and dye combination attached specifically to P. gingivalis. Other bacterial species and healthy human gum cells were left unaffected.

When the researchers illuminated the targeted bacteria with near-infrared light, the activated dye damaged their outer membranes, ultimately killing them.

Microscopic examination revealed an notable difference between this technique and conventional antimicrobial light therapy. Bacteria exposed to the new treatment developed tiny openings in their membranes but largely maintained their overall shape. By contrast, conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy caused the bacteria to break apart completely.

The distinction matters because destroying bacterial cells can release substances that contribute to inflammation. Preserving the overall structure of the targeted bacteria, even after killing them, could help limit this unwanted effect.

Recent findings suggest that the researchers also examined how the treatments affected healthy human gum cells. Their targeted therapy caused no detectable harm to these cells, while conventional antimicrobial photodynamic therapy produced cellular damage and slowed healing.

Latest Treatment Reduces Bone Loss in Mice.

The team next investigated whether these laboratory findings would translate into meaningful improvements in gum disease.

In mice with periodontitis, the experimental therapy significantly reduced the loss of alveolar bone, the part of the jawbone that surrounds and supports teeth. Preventing this type of bone deterioration is especially crucial because advanced periodontitis can loosen teeth and eventually cause them to fall out.

In a recent development, analysis of the animals' saliva revealed another encouraging result. The treatment reduced P. gingivalis while preserving beneficial Streptococcus bacteria, helping maintain a healthier balance of microorganisms in the mouth.

Conventional antibiotics and antimicrobial photodynamic therapy, on the other hand, eliminated both harmful and beneficial bacteria in the experiments, causing broader disruption to the oral microbial community.

"Results demonstrated that, unlike antibiotics or standard light therapy, this approach selectively removes the primary pathogenic species while preserving the remainder of the oral bacterial community," Sato stated.

Together, the findings suggest that targeting individual disease-causing bacteria could help control gum disease while avoiding some of the unintended consequences of broader antimicrobial treatments.

AI Could Help Develop More Precise Gum Disease Treatments.

Although the early results are promising, the researchers recognize that periodontitis is a complex disease involving multiple bacterial species. Eliminating P. gingivalis alone may not be sufficient to treat every case.

According to recent reports, to address this challenge, the team intends to use artificial intelligence (AI) to examine publicly available information about oral bacteria. By identifying other important microorganisms and studying how different species interact, they hope to uncover additional targets for future therapies.

The researchers also see potential implications beyond oral health. Periodontitis has been linked to several other medical conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and diabetes.

According to recent reports, understanding the relationships between oral bacteria and these conditions could eventually help scientists identify which patients are most likely to benefit from specific treatments. AI analysis may play a role in making those decisions and guiding the development of more personalized approaches to gum disease.

According to recent reports, for now, the therapy remains experimental, with its effectiveness demonstrated in laboratory studies and mice rather than human clinical trials. However, the findings point toward a possible future in which treating gum disease means selectively removing harmful bacteria instead of disrupting the entire microbial community that helps keep the mouth healthy.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Every game, every genre, all of the Apple Arcade essentials you need to know about.

According to recent reports, if you get spoiled for choice when browsing through the Apple Arcade library, we can't blame you. There are well over 100 games in the incredible service, and you can spend hundreds of hours playing through them all. So the question is, where is best to spend your time? What is Apple Arcade? Apple Arcade is a subscription service that you can use on all of your Apple devices, including your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV or Mac. It allows you to play games from a list that includes over 180 games at the moment, and your progress is transferred between devices, meaning you can continue where you left off. It's really handy, and the Apple Arcade games list gets expanded often, so you'll always have fresh games to play.

Industry observers note that no matter what kind of game you're looking for, you'll find it on these pages. Here we've put together a comprehensive Apple Arcade games list of every title presently released, in the order of release, with the genres included so you can find exactly what you want.

Apple Arcade games list 2026 Just take a look below, and you'll find everything you need to know about every game that's on the Apple Arcade games list of 2026, sorted by genre and release date (latest first).

Crossy Road Rush (Hipster Whale).

It has been revealed that hipster Whale's blocky Frogger-like is running down a different path in Crossy Road Rush. Now, you'll dash across an island, hopping from place to place while trying to avoid colliding with walls and other obstacles.

Yes, the beloved survival crafting game is now available on Apple Arcade, complete with Dead Cells and Palworld crossover content.

It won't be easy, though. You'll need to battle off hordes of enemies and take down other cult leaders to help boost your own.

Everyone's favourite grumpy avians are back with a slight twist. Rather than flinging themselves at their porcine foes, this time you'll take down the piggies in a brick breaker-style setup. Okay, so there's still an element of flinging.

Industry observers note that everything you need to know is pretty much in the title. Katamari Damacy sees you rolling a stick ball that grows bigger as more and more items become stuck to it.

Punch Kick Duck+ (Shaun Coleman).

Battle your way to the top of the tower where success lies in how good your timing is and whether or not you pick the right move.

The third main instalment in the Zelda-like series takes place 1000 years after Oceanhorn 2, bringing you a completely latest adventure. You'll have to battle through the Shadow Sea, which doesn't sound like a pleasant place for a cruise.

SpongeBob: Patty Pursuit (Viacom).

Head down to Bikini Bottom for some side-scrolling action with everyone's favourite sponge. He's on a mission to find his missing fry cook station while Plankton joins him because his inventions have also been stolen.

Return to Monkey Island+ (Terrible Toybox).

This one's for the point-and-click adventure fans out there, particularly those who have previously enjoyed Ron Gilbert's work.

In this adventure, you'll form a team of Ubisoft's critters and use their special powers to vanquish your foes.

Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom (Bandai Namco Entertainment).

In this colourful game, your goal is to restore the titular kingdom to its former glory by building and decorating your wilderness camp before inviting your Tamagotchi pals to enjoy it with you.

Recent findings suggest that from the creators of What the Golf? Comes What the Car?, a silly racing game where you can roll, jump, fly and even sneeze your way to the finish line. You play as a car, but rather than having wheels, you have a pair of legs. It's as fun as it is absurd.

Very Little Nightmares+ (Bandai Namco).

Very Little Nightmares is a puzzle adventure game where you are tasked with escaping The Nest, a giant maze littered with traps.

Enjoy the incredibly atmospheric Limbo as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You play as a young boy who is looking for his sister and must traverse a deadly world to find her by solving puzzles and jumping over perilous gaps.

Old Man's Journey+ (Broken Rules).

Old Man's Journey+ is an emotional adventure that focuses on life's precious moments and intends that need to be changed.

Monument Valley 2+ (ustwo games).

According to recent reports, the critically acclaimed adventure game Monument Valley 2 is now available through Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it sees players guiding a mother and her child through a world filled with magical architecture.

Gibbon: Beyond the Trees (Broken Rules).

According to recent reports, the developers of Old Man's Journey and ELOH has returned with a game that looks to emulate the way gibbons swing from tree to tree. Meanwhile, the narrative tackles topics such as deforestation, poaching, and climate change.

Wylde Flowers is a life and farming sim, but with magical spells thrown in for good measure. You take on the role of Tara, who arrives on the island to help her grandma with the family farm. It promises to provide a whole adventure as you explore magical realms, beaches and forests.

Dandara: Trials of Fear+ (Raw Fury).

It has been revealed that raw Fury's Metroidvania Dandara: Trials of Fear can now be enjoyed as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. It sees you battling to save the world of Salt from an imminent collapse.

LEGO Star Wars: Castaways (Gameloft).

It has been revealed that in Star Wars: Castaways, you will explore a mysterious planet that has been abandoned for a long time. Throughout the game, you will make new friends and battle against some imposing enemies.

In Monument Valley, you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the completely wild.

A beautiful adventure game that explores how everyone can make a difference in the world even with the smallest of actions.

Sources indicate that all of You is a cute, purely visual, accessible, family-friendly puzzle adventure with unique gameplay. Play and pause time in every part of the level to unveil the right path for the main character.

The Last Campfire is an adventure, a story of a lost ember trapped in a puzzling place, searching for meaning and a way home.

It has been revealed that the ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

Sequel to the classic adventure game Beneath a Steel Sky.

Beyond Blue takes you into the near future, where you’ll have the opportunity to explore the mysteries of our ocean through the eyes of Mirai, a deep-sea explorer and scientist.

Live the life of a Sasquatch and do regular, everyday Sasquatch stuff like: Sneak around campsites. Disguise yourself in human clothing.

FreeCell Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

According to recent reports, pretty much as it says on the tin. FreeCell Solitaire lets you enjoy the classic card game in as straightforward a way as possible. No bells and whistles needed here.

Uno: Arcade Edition (Mattel163).

If ruining long-standing friendships is your idea of fun, then you might want to give Uno: Arcade Edition a try. It's the classic card game we all love to get frustrated by with a few intriguing twists to the existing formula.

Crazy Eights: Card Games+ (MobilityWare).

Sources indicate that dip into some of your favourite tabletop card games with Crazy Eights. It has numerous modes to enjoy that mix up the rules, helping keep things fresh.

Texas Hold'em Poker: Pokerist+ (KamaGames).

No real surprises here, simply a way to play poker online, pitting your skills against other players to win major.

LocalThunk's Balatro exploded in popularity when it released early in 2024. The simple concept of creating strong poker hands combined with deckbuilding, tactics and even some maths has led to it being viewed as one of the best games of the year. And now you can play it on your phone!

Monster Train+ (Good Shepherd Entertainment).

According to recent reports, if you haven't played this excellent roguelike deckbuilder and happen to have an Apple Arcade subscription, you're now in luck. Monster Train sees you riding on the titular locomotive on a journey to restore a frozen hell to its former glory. Well, if hell is ever glorious, I suppose.

Blackjack by Mobility (Mobility Ware).

In a recent development, this one's fairly self-explanatory, you can play the card game 21. You have unlimited chips too, so you can play against the dealer to your heart's content.

Pocket Card Jockey: Ride On (Game Freak).

Sources indicate that pocket Card Jockey: Ride On is a game that combines solitaire and horse racing. The game previously released on Nintendo 3DS but is now available as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Gin Rummy Classic+ (MobilityWare).

It has been revealed that learn to play Gin Rummy using tutorials and perfect your skills against bots offline. The aim is simple: you want to create the best hand possible by picking up or drawing one card at a time.

Spider Solitaire: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Enjoy the classic card game Spider Solitaire as part of your Apple Arcade subscription.

Hearts: Card Game+ (MobilityWare).

Now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

Recent findings suggest that the addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a upcoming game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaires.

Pusheen's Place (Electric Square).

If the idea of adorable cat-like creatures appeals to you, then Pusheens is worth checking out. You'll gather a veritable army of them before popping them in their new home, which you can also customise.

Industry observers note that unpacking is a Zen puzzler that sees you moving house several times over a period of time. It's entirely designed for relaxing, so you don't have to worry about timers, scores or any of that business. Just kick back and enjoy.

A bunch of evil monsters and villains need serving, and it's up to you to fulfil their orders.

The most famous and most popular endless runner is now available on Apple Arcade. Race along those tracks and grab coins to your heart's content without fear of any adverts of in-app purchases required.

It has been revealed that cleaning might not sound fun on the surface, but trust me, you'll love it in PowerWash Simulator. Armed with a powerful jet washer, you'll have to blast the muck off house, vehicles and other objects until they're spick and span. It's incredibly satisfying.

Piffle+ sees you slinging adorable cats around levels to break all the blocks. It's a simple premise, but trickier to do in practice.

Industry observers note that suika Game is deceptively simple. All you have to do is get two of the same fruit to come into contact with one another so they merge to form a larger fruit, with the ultimate goal being to create a watermelon. It sounds straightforward and perhaps a little dull, but before you know it, an hour's passed and you'll be itching to make more watermelons.

Helix Jump tasks you with guiding your ball through a series of twisted towers using physics-based movement.

In a recent development, there are few games as synonymous with mobile as Doodle Jump, and now this classic is available on Apple Arcade. The concept is simple, yet inherently compulsive. You can waste many hours on this one.

Talking Tom Blast Park (Outfit7).

Another entry in Outfit7's popular franchises, Talking Tom Blast Park sees the titular hero embarking on an adventure to stop Rakoonz.

Smash Hit+ sees you smash through an ethereal dimension in time with music. It promises to be a meditative experience despite the destruction you're leaving in your wake.

In a recent development, while Furista is a push as a pun, I'm happy for it count as a fan of felines. In this game, you adopt cats before matching your customers with them to make their visit to your cafe as fluffy and enjoyable as possible.

In a recent development, collect and nurture fish so they become what they were always destined to be... Dragons! That's right. Zen Koi Pro+ is a relaxing experience that follows the Asian myth that koi can become dragons with enough care and attention.

Delicious – Miracle of Life+ (GameHouse).

According to recent reports, the popular casual management sim is now part of Apple Arcade. It follows Emily as she looks to progress her career while preparing to become a parent.

If you've ever wanted to build your own farm, this might be the game for you. Farmside allows you to place plots, plant crops and harvest them. Beyond that, you can raise animals and spend time designing your farm's layout.

Industry observers note that 2017's App Store Game of the Year is now available through Apple Arcade. The aim is simple, you have to search for the titular hidden folks across numerous levels. There are over 300 in total with 32 hand-drawn areas to investigate.

Another of MobilityWare's card games is now available on Apple Arcade. This time you can play Spades as much as you'd like. The aim is to work with a partner to try and out-bid your opponents while trying to reach 250 points first.

Sources indicate that now you can enjoy the classic card game Hearts as part of your Apple Arcade subscription. You can test your skills against AI that adapts to your playstyle to make sure you stay on your toes.

Experience the classic card game with a plethora of beautiful deck designs, daily challenges and explore your competitive nature by trying to climb the leaderboards.

The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.

Like its footwear namesake — Flipflop Solitaire is unrestrictive, creating a new game for fans of spider, klondike and other traditional Solitaire games.

Blast off into outer space with an intergalactic indie rock band in the latest instalment in the popular Reigns series.

Recent findings suggest that bring your friends and see how far you can get in this endless spinning tower of arcade fun! Keep climbing as high as you can. Every run is different.

Would you believe me if I told you that there's a puzzler about folding paper that's incredibly beautiful? If you're an origami fan, most likely. But to anyone else, it'll be a pleasant surprise in Kami 2+.

Block Blast is one of those simple yet endlessly engaging puzzlers. All you have to do is match blocks on an 8-by-8 grid and then enjoy them all exploding. However, it's never quite that simple, constantly asking you to think deeper than you might expect.

Art of Fauna: Cosy Puzzles+ (Klemens Strasser).

Sources indicate that if you love nature and puzzles, then Art of Fauna is perfect for you. It sees you essentially putting together some beautiful artwork, with each accompanied by some text about the depicted animal.

Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ (Tripledot Studios).

A colourful and relaxing puzzler that will keep you occupied for hours and hours.

Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+ (Fanatee).

It's a bunch of puzzles you can do every day, right? Pretty much! There is a mix of word puzzles and brain teasers for you to tackle each day to keep your mind strong.

Fancy yourself as an artist? Draw It gives you the opportunity to prove it, tasking you with sketching out a visual depiction of a word before the time runs out.

Perchang World (Perchang World).

Perchang is a physics-based puzzler that takes you through a series of colour environments. It's wacky fun that's all narrated by popular British comedian, James Acaster.

Industry observers note that flow Free is as simple as puzzlers can get. However, don't expect it to be easy. Connect up colours might sound straightforward, but it becomes very tricky over time.

Sources indicate that if you love pretty colours and solving puzzles, then I Love Hue Too+ is for you. It sees you rearranging mosaic tiles to make beautiful creations.

Recent findings suggest that let's Go Mightycat! (ponos corporation).

In a recent development, the Battle Cats now have a spin-off! Now you can fling them at blocky towers. It might sound straightforward, but making them all tumble to the ground isn't as easy as you might think.

Lost in Play+ (Snapbreak Games).

Lost in Play is a story about a brother and sister trying to find their way home. To do so, you will need to solve a series of puzzles alongside chatting with some whimsical creatures.

Words of Wonders: Search+ (Fugo Bilism).

Sources indicate that no great surprises here, Words of Wonder: Search+ is... a word search! That's right. It pretty much does exactly what it indicates on the tin. So if hunting for a list of words is your jam, you're well catered to here.

It has been revealed that sumi Sumi: Matching Puzzle+ (Imagineer Co. Ltd).

Sumi Sumi is a puzzler that tasks you with matching popular characters from San-X together while enjoying all the beautiful animations that accompany doing so.

Sources indicate that what do you get if you mix stickers with jigsaws? puffies. That's what! Designed to be a calming experience, it tasks you with open sticker packs before piecing together the various puzzles.

Put your word skills to the test with Zynga's Arcade edition of the popular puzzler Boggle.

Wheel of Fortune Daily (Frosty Pop).

Industry observers note that if you're a fan of Wheel of Fortune and fans of daily puzzles, this game is exactly what you're looking. Each day, you will have to solve one, with plenty of variety promising to keep it fresh every time.

Enjoy some match-3 puzzling with a delightful cast of colourful characters.

Super Monsters Ate My Condo+ (PikPok).

Super Monsters Ate My Condo brings some whacky match-3 to the table. This new and updated version offers improved visuals but, thankfully, leaves the gameplay we all know and love untouched.

The popular tile-matching puzzler comes to Apple Arcade. It sees you popping the titular Puyos across several different game modes.

Industry observers note that words in Progress sees you combining letters to create words. You can either find how long you can survive in Endless Mode or test your word crafting prowess against other players.

In a recent development, cornsweeper promises to be a meditative puzzler where the aim is to avoid explosions going off. It draws heavy inspiration from Minesweeper, as you might have guessed by the name!

Puzzle & Dragons Story (GungHo Online Entertainment).

The popular series brings its blend of match-3 puzzling and RPG elements to Apple Arcade. By matching colours, you will battle your way through deadly dungeons while recruiting latest companions to help you in the fight.

Knotwords is a word puzzler that brings together elements of Sudoku and crosswords.

Crossword Jam+ (PlaySimple Games).

Train your brain by engaging with a series of crossword-style games that see you looking to create words.

Om Nom is back in the third instalment in the popular puzzler series. The aim is to reunite Nibble Nom and Om Nom on each stage by engaging with the various mechanics that the game has to offer.

finity. is a matching game with three simple rules to follow. But that doesn't mean it's going to be easy as you attempt to climb the leaderboards.

Nekograms is an adorable puzzler where the goal is to help every cat you encounter fall asleep. To do this, you have to move the felines and cushions around until they've found the perfect place to curl into a ball and nap.

Bold Moves+ is a puzzler where you match tiles to solve a series of word puzzles. It offers a mixture of daily and weekly events alongside plenty of levels to work through.

Disney SpellStruck (Artist Arcade).

Disney SpellStruck is a word puzzler that takes place on The Isles of Tiles. It tasks you with solving a bunch of crossword-like games with popular Disney and Pixar characters like Mickey Mouse, Stitch, and Tinkerbell.

Disney Getaway Blast+ (Gameloft).

Industry observers note that make your way through a series of matching puzzle games while working on your own tropical island. Along the way, you can get help from beloved Disney and Pixar characters, with each bringing special power-ups.

Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist (Tilting: Point).

If you enjoy the popular BBC sci-fi series and puzzlers, then Doctor Who: An Unlikely Heist might be for you. It sees you finding hidden objects and solving a series of puzzles.

Human: Fall Flat+ is now available on Apple Arcade. It's a jokey physics-based platformer that can be enjoyed on your own or with four pals.

Castle Crumble (Orbital Knight).

It has been revealed that if the title didn't make it clear enough, Castle Crumble is all about toppling strongholds. Using a mixture of explosives and spells, you will travel through different time periods destroying castles as you go.

Illustrated is a puzzler where the solutions lie in the images in front of you as well as the story. When you beat each story, each illustration is unveiled in full colour.

Recent findings suggest that as the name implies, stitch. is a game all about embroidery. The aim is to fill in each area without leaving any gaps. The game calls them Hoops, and they come in different shapes and sizes, ranging from landscapes to plants to animals.

Garden Tails: Match and Grow (Playdots).

Industry observers note that garden Tails: Match and Grow is a relaxing puzzler for fans of wildlife and nature. It sees you building your own garden by completing match-3 puzzles to unlock upcoming flowers, bushes and critters.

Jigsaw Puzzle by MobilityWare+ (MobilityWare).

Jigsaw Puzzle is exactly what it indicates on the tin. You can sit back, relax, and solve a series of jigsaw puzzles. There are 26,000 of them in total from well-known brands, including Disney and Hasbro.

It has been revealed that prune is a beautiful game that serves as a love letter to nature, and specifically trees. It sees you growing and shaping your tree with simple swipe controls. The goal is to guide them towards the sunlight while avoiding the many dangers the world presents.

Moonshot – A Journey Home (Noodlecake).

Moonshot is a physics-based puzzler that tasks you with guiding Moon Pi – a moon who has become separated from Earth – back home. It uses drag and release mechanics as you launch Moon Pi past the gravity fields of other planets. There are also other obstacles to dodge, such as black holes and aliens.

It has been revealed that as the title suggests, Bridge Constructor tests players' bridge assembly prowess across 40 levels. You will need to make sure they can withstand constant use from cars and other heavy vehicles like trucks and super-heavy tank trucks.

Splitter Critters+ (RAC7 Games).

Recent findings suggest that splitter Critters is a cute puzzler where the aim is to guide the little creatures safely back to their spaceship. To do this you will be able to split the world into different pieces to create a path the critters can traverse.

Temple Run: Puzzle Adventure is a match-3 take on the well-known franchise. You will look to create powerful combs to make special pieces that allow you to become a Temple Champion.

Zookeeper World is a match-3 puzzler that allows players to create their own zoo. The more levels they beat, the more animals, plants and accessories they'll unlock to use in their zoo.

Recent findings suggest that checkers, your latest free checker game (also known as Draughts), will entertain you for hours! It’s challenging with 5 different levels, yet relaxing and beautiful with 8 different designs.

When the tranquillity of suburban life is threatened by a huge building site, Simon and his cat mobilise the neighbours to help restore the mysterious wasteland before the diggers destroy it all.

A 3-D colour-matching game that sees players being tasked with toppling a series of mysterious towers that have appeared in the kingdom.

A quiet, sombre adventure best experienced with a loved one.

Eat loads of pills and pellets while chasing ghosts with your friends!

Embark on an epic hand-animated adventure from Zach Gage, Pendleton Ward, and Choice Provisions. Cast powerful spells, slay fantastic monsters, discover ancient secrets, and ultimately save the world — just by picking up the right cards.

Recent findings suggest that dear Reader lets you curl up and play your favourite books, turning classic literature into clever word puzzles. Unscramble passages from famous books, unlock unique puzzles and add latest books to your library.

Grindstone is a puzzle-meets-action hybrid that will see you slashing through dozens of meaningless monsters on a path of destruction and carnage. Beautiful.

Patterned is a unique puzzle game that immerses you in the beauty and joy of seamless, repeating patterns.

Tint lets you solve puzzles by painting. Mix watercolours to match the colour of the origami - all at a soothing pace and in the comfort of your own garden studio.

Industry observers note that where Cards Fall is a slice-of-life story where you build houses of cards to bring formative memories to life. Create pathways through dreamlike spatial puzzles to navigate the insecurities and emotions of high school and beyond.

Lego Hill Climb Adventures+ (Fingersoft).

Lego Hill Climb Adventures brings a mixture of exploration, racing, and upgrading to the table, all presented with everyone's favourite building blocks.

Lego Friends Heartlake Rush+ (StoryToys Limited).

Hop in various Lego vehicles and race through Heartlake City in high-octane action that sees you dodging traffic and roadblocks on your journey to be the fastest pile of bricks on the course.

Hot Wheels: Race Off+ (Hutch Games).

Enjoy some Hot Wheels-branded racing action in this game with all the loop the loops you could ever hope for.

Hill Climb Racing+ (Fingersoft).

Recent findings suggest that the classic game is now available on Apple Arcade. You play as Bill, an aspiring uphill racer as he drives a series of unique vehicles up hills and over obstacles.

Horizon Chase 2 is a fast-paced arcade racer with gameplay inspired by the genre's best entries from the '90s.

Recent findings suggest that gear.Club Stradale is all about supercars. You and your friends can start your own club in Tuscany, Italy and drive expensive cars from manufacturers like Bugatti, Porsche and McLaren.

Race with your favourite characters from several beloved cartoons, such as American Dad!, Family Guy, King of the Hill and Solar Opposite.

Sources indicate that enjoy Gameloft's popular racing game without any microtransactions. There are over 250 licensed vehicles from the likes of Ferrari, Ducati, Lamborghini and many more.

Race on mobile with Sonic and his friends.

Dungeon Clawler+ (Stray Fawn Studio).

Recent findings suggest that dungeon Clawler is a roguelike deckbuilder that uses the claw machine as a way to grab various items. It's a fun twist on the usual formula, and this claw actually grabs things, unlike those you find in UK arcades.

Hyke: Northerine Light(s) (Akatsuki Games).

It has been revealed that if you like your RPGs doused in pixelated goodness, then you might want to check out Hyke. Playing as the titular character, you set out on a journey to find your missing mother. Along the way, Hyke's witch powers will come in handy against the threats you face.

Black Salt Games' excellent Dredge has now moored on Apple Arcade. If you're unfamiliar, it's essentially a relaxing fishing sim, until it suddenly isn't. You see, Eldritch nightmares are lurking in the depths that will do their best to destroy your humble vessel.

Final Fantasy IV: The After Years+ (Square Enix).

Ever wondered what happened after Final Fantasy IV? Well, in The After Years, you can play out that tale. This version is a full 3D remake too, so it looks better than ever.

Final Fantasy IV (3D Remake) + (Square Enix).

You can now play the 1991 classic on your iPhone or iPad with additional features compared to the original.

Stardew Valley+ (Concerned Ape).

According to recent reports, stardew Valley is a game that needs no introduction if you've previously indulged in its cosy world of breeding animals and growing crops. If you are unfamiliar, it's an open-ended RPG where you can not only manage a farm but also settle down and make a family while participating in community events.

Slay the Spire+ (Humble Bundle).

The quintessential deck-building roguelike is now available on Apple Arcade. Slay the Spire has remained at the top of this sub-genre because it's still comfortably one of the best.

My Town Home – Family Games+ (My Town Games).

Explore a doll's house with over six different rooms to explore. There are multiple members of the family to meet, each with a different pet.

Episode XOXO (Episode Interactive).

Episode XOXO promises a constantly growing library of interactive stories where your choices will influence the narrative.

First launched in 2014, Battleheart Legacy is now available on Apple Arcade. You can choose from several typical fantasy classes before heading into battle to vanquish nasty beasties.

In this crafting-based RPG, you will take on the role of Flux Dabes, a galactic trucker who needs to recover his missing packages after becoming stranded on an alien planet.

Industry observers note that embark on an adventure where you will collect Monsties and form bonds with them. This revamped version of the game includes graphical improvements and a better user interface.

Fantasian is an exciting, new RPG set against a spectacular backdrop made from over 150 handmade dioramas that blend physical environments and 3D characters.

Engage in an epic storyline for control of the mysterious Nexus and the fate of the universe as players step into the role of their favourite Star Trek heroes and villains in the hit franchise's official team-based RPG.

It has been revealed that join the Crystal Gems for the ultimate mobile RPG. It’s time to Unleash the Light!

Unleash the Light features an original story co-written by Rebecca Sugar, and voiceover from the Steven Universe cast and special guest star Christine Baranski.

Sources indicate that A young Knight faces an impossible challenge, as Warlock Mesmeroth has returned with a formidable Dark Army. Will our hero be able to unite the Owrus, Gillfolk, and men in a fight for the fate of the world?

Food Stylist – Design Game+ (Zeste).

While food is mainly for eating, that doesn't mean it can't look good too. In Food Stylist, that's your job: make every dish look as good as it tastes.

Pocket City 2+ (Engaged Labs Inc).

Recent findings suggest that as the name implies, Pocket City 2 sees you creating your own city. But it's not all stuffy business meetings and financials. You can also participate in street races and basketball challenges. It's a fun place, evidently.

Outfit7's popular virtual pet sim is now on Apple Arcade! You'll have to look after your new pal, making sure he's fed and happy.

If running a coffee empire is something you've always dreamed of, then now is your chance to make it a reality. Well, virtually, anyway. And it's not just one place either; you can expand your business across the world, taking over Tokyo, Paris, Berlin, and Amsterdam. Watch out, Starbucks.

Good Pizza, Great Pizza+ (Tapblaze).

According to recent reports, who doesn't like pizza? Anyone who answers that question with “Me” simply cannot be trusted. I'm sure we all agree. In Good Pizza, Great Pizza, you get to run your own business, serving customers one of the greatest foods ever created.

Industry observers note that before houses became incredibly hard to afford, the dream was building your own home with your partner. Pocket Love!+ allows you to make it a virtual reality in a cute and cosy package.

Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story+ (Kairosoft).

Running a sweet shop sounds like every kid's dream, and you can make it a reality thanks to Kairosoft.

My Talking Tom Friends+ (Outfit7)strong>.

Join up with Tom, Angela, Hank, Ginger, Ben, and Becca as the beloved group of friends arrive on Apple Arcade.

RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic+ (Atari).

Industry observers note that anyone who loves theme parks probably has a vision in their head for what their ideal version of one is. In RollerCoaster Tycoon, you can live out that fantasy, building the perfect park for everyone to enjoy.

According to recent reports, pretty much as the title implies, HyperBeard's My Dear Farm sees you creating your own farm. It's a laid-back experience that allows you to decorate your buildings and grow your crops without any of the stresses and strains of real-life agriculture.

In a recent development, do you like food and dogs? Then this might be the game for you. As the name accurately describes, it sees you opening a crepe shop, with the goal of opening them up across the world.

Disney Dreamlight Valley (Gameloft).

Head to a land where Disney and Pixar characters co-exist, where everything was lovely until the Forgetting happened, bringing darkness to an otherwise magical place. It's up to you to put that right!

It has been revealed that A jovial adventure through the oil rush in 19th-century North America. Become an entrepreneur and help grow your business and, subsequently, your town.

Football Manager 2024 Touch (Sega).

Put together your dream team in the latest instalment of the popular football management sim.

Japanese Rural Life Adventure (Game Start).

As the name perfectly describes, this is a simulation that lets you experience life in the Japanese countryside. You will fix up an old house and then go about your business however you life, whether that's growing crops or going fishing.

My Talking Angela 2+ (Outfit7 Limited).

In My Talking Angela 2, you will keep the titular character occupied, whether that's through baking, making music, or learning new dance moves.

Kingdoms: Merge & Build (Cherrypick Games).

Following the destruction of the kingdom, it's up to you to restore it to its former majesty by merging hundreds of items.

In a recent development, outfit7's virtual pet simulator is now available on Apple Arcade. Chat with the titular feline as you collect different pieces of furniture and other fashionable items. Aside from playing with Tom, you can also enjoy a host of different mini-games.

Construction Simulator 2+ (astragon Entertainment).

Industry observers note that as the pretty self-explanatory title implies, Construction Simulator 2 sees you building a construction company while making use of over 40 originally licensed vehicles. This includes companies such as Caterpillar, Liebherr, Palfinger, Bell, Still, Atlas, and Mack Trucks, among others.

Collect more than 40 varieties of cats by placing enticing toys and snacks for them in your yard.

Game Dev Story+ allows you to create your own game organization, looking to make millions from the development of a best-selling video game.

Industry observers note that mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running.

Touchgrind BMX 2+ (Illusion Labs).

In a recent development, extreme sports without the danger of breaking your neck. Yes, Touchgrind BMX 2 lets you pull off trick combos that usually end in tears in real life, so you can enjoy some of the thrill with no downside!

Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition (Electronic Arts).

Lead your favourite NFL team to glory in the latest instalment in EA's long-running series.

Retro Bowl College+ (New Star Games).

If the college football scene is more your cup of tea, Retro Bowl has you covered. There are over 250 to choose from before leading them to the top of the college circuit.

Mini Football Legends (Miniclip).

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Have you grown your moustache out for November? It’s never too late to join in, and there's always time to check up on your teammates.

In a recent development, if you play WARDOGS (see our preview here) or are about to check it out, here’s a nice reason to do so. WARDOGS and Movember have teamed up for the chilly month of November for a mental health collab to raise awareness about men’s health and mental health. It’s time to give a virtual hand to your teammates on and off the battlefield while you keep earning coin.

Until November 30th, you’ll be able to keep your upper lip warmer (over the ski mask) as you shoot your way out of hairy situations with the Movember Pack DLC.

Recent findings suggest that just like it’s vital to check on your teammates, it’s a good time to check on your mates as well. Drop by, send a message, see how they’re doing with everything going on in the world; it’s better to join forces and fight missions together with maximum health possible, after all.

Just like a real stache, the WARDOGS DLC special starts small but keeps growing as the player uses it, so it becomes quite impressively curved after a few hours in the field.

Players who take part in this charity drive also get a badge called the November 2026 Scoreboard Badge, which is permanent to show that they participated in the men’s health event.

Unfortunately, the stache itself only is available to use during November, as does the Movember event only exist in November, but that doesn’t mean that one should only check on his pals during one month a year.

Many things can happen to one’s friends, and prevention remains the best weapon in the game, with both mental health and screenings for prostate and testicular cancer.

Men have a higher rate of suicide and are less likely to be vocal about mental health challenges due to social pressure and expectations, but thankfully we’ve been managing to move the needle in the right direction; there is still a lot of work to be done, not just by Movember but by men as a whole.

Industry observers note that we all have different methods of how to ease up, and for many men, it is gaming. Multiplayer titles in particular are great to unite with buddies after a long day at work or during some downtime at the weekend.

Sometimes just talking to a friend while multitasking with a controller can do wonders for mental health, on top of pushing away the loneliness.

Just like a real stache, it starts small but keeps growing with the player using it.

Beyond being a sick cosmetic, the WARDOGS Tactical 'Stache is a powerful conversation starter. Movember has become a cultural phenomenon, and it's only natural for it to makes waves in games.

Just like you heal a teammate or check if he’s got enough mags during a firefight, check if he’s got enough energy for the day ahead or after a round of WARDOGS. Rep your moustaches with your mates as another community cosmetic to show how handsome all you lads are.

100% of the net profits of Movember Tactical 'Stache DLC (after platform fees, sales tax and refunds) go to Movember, funding research in prostate cancer, testicular cancer, mental health and suicide prevention.

According to recent reports, WARDOGS is a first-person multiplayer shooter presently available for Windows in early access. The game is expected to be available on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X/S in 2028.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Marvel Cosmic Invasion was a bit of a dream game for me; I loved the X-Men arcade game in the '90s, so when Tribute Games released the excellent Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge in 2022, I immediately hoped they'd revitalize other licensed brawler franchises released by Konami in the late '80s and early '90s.

  • Seeing that Annihilus is threatening the universe, Doom decides to take matters into his own hands.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Marvel Cosmic Invasion was a bit of a dream game for me; I loved the X-Men arcade game in the '90s, so when Tribute Games released the excellent Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge in 2022, I immediately hoped they'd revitalize other licensed brawler franchises released by Konami in the late '80s and early '90s. While we still haven't heard any word of a new brawler starring The Simpsons, Tribute did follow up its Turtle triumph with Marvel Cosmic Invasion, another throwback side-scrolling beat 'em up, this time starring Marvel's mightiest.

Industry observers note that I played through Marvel Cosmic Invasion multiple times and had a blast, but I moved on rapidly, as I didn't feel the need to collect different palette-swaps of the many heroes on offer. Even after Cyclops and The Thing joined the roster as DLC in May, I still saw Cosmic Invasion as a game in the rearview. That changes this week, as The Siege of Castle Doom not only adds two additional playable characters (Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom), but also a mode that has the potential to bring me back for more runs for the foreseeable future.

Seeing that Annihilus is threatening the universe, Doom decides to take matters into his own hands. Unfortunately, much in the way that it seems that he may try to fix the multiversal incursions in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday, Victor Von Doom's solution in Marvel Cosmic Invasion – the Cosmic Inductor – would lead to untold death and destruction. In The Siege of Castle Doom, you select your team and fight your way through various floors of the stronghold belonging to the man who is perhaps Marvel's greatest villain. Your goal is to fight through the winding, randomized hallways of Castle Doomstadt, charging Reed Richards' Stabilizer and tactically bolstering your team along the way, before Doctor Doom can enact his blueprint.

According to recent reports, as for the new playable characters, Doctor Doom is less agile, but his attacks pack a whallop, while Invisible Woman's force fields and speed make her the more versatile pick. I don't know that I see either of them replacing my mains from the base game, but I had fun experimenting with them throughout this mode. Regardless of which character you choose from the expanding roster, you still must traverse Castle Doomstadt before Doom achieves his objective.

It has been revealed that fighting through waves of enemies across differently themed and booby-trapped rooms, you encounter all manner of foes from the base game, as well as fresh minion types from Doom. When you defeat enemies, they drop batteries that charge your Stabilizer, letting you even the odds and stop Doom. Conversely, each time an enemy hits your character, it charges Doom's Cosmic Inductor, inching him closer to victory and making his minions faster and stronger in the process. As you might expect, the rooms get harder the deeper you go, and while each player starts with two characters to swap between, if a character completely depletes their health, they're gone for good, making it even tougher. As such, you need to keep your eyes on each character's health and swap them out when it makes sense.

As you complete each room, you can choose which path to take to augment your characters with new special abilities. True to the roguelite structure, as you complete rooms, you can also buff your characters' stats within the run. Certain rooms offer extra batteries to help your Stabilizer charge, while others offer new and upgraded equipment. There's also one that promises random events that can easily alter the trajectory of your run for better or worse. Though I often enjoyed boosting attack stats to make enemies less like damage sponges, I had to balance that against buffing their health to keep them alive and charging the Stabilizer to have a fighting chance.

Beyond the in-run upgrades and modifiers, you can also amp up the action run-over-run through upgrades in Reed's Lab, which add to the pool of modifiers you can select from at the start of each run. The expansion also adds new palettes for existing heroes, plus new music by composer Tee Lopes. While I've only done a few runs of The Siege of Castle Doom (each taking between 45 and 90 minutes, depending on how successful you are), I feel a revitalized sense of excitement for Marvel Cosmic Invasion. Tribute claims completionists can spend upwards of 15 hours in this new mode, which has me champing at the bit to dive back into what will likely be my primary way of interacting with Marvel Cosmic Invasion going forward.

Marvel Cosmic Invasion – The Siege of Castle Doom is available today on all platforms, and it is a strong addition to an already great game. You can read our review of the base version of Marvel Cosmic Invasion here.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that battlefield 6’s promised, season-extending enhancement has been officially detailed.
  • Enhancement 1.1.3.5 does, of course, have a change log of its own that goes beyond just the season’s extension, but the changes fall somewhere between not very exciting, and a bit puzzling.
  • In a recent development, patch 1.1.3.5 is, for all intents and purposes, a smaller revision.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that battlefield 6’s promised, season-extending enhancement has been officially detailed. The patch, version 1.1.3.5, arrives tomorrow, January 20 right when Season 1 was supposed to end. Part of the update’s goal is to extend the current season, until Season 2 kicks off in the middle of February.

Enhancement 1.1.3.5 does, of course, have a change log of its own that goes beyond just the season’s extension, but the changes fall somewhere between not very exciting, and a bit puzzling.

In a recent development, patch 1.1.3.5 is, for all intents and purposes, a smaller revision. When Battlefield Studios announced it earlier last week, the developer didn’t promise any major changes or fixes, so expectations never got out of hand.

The patch is mainly made up of bug fixes, but it does have three key areas of improvements to gameplay. There’s a big focus on melee combat, how responsive/unresponsive it is with the various melee tools, and how melee behaviour interacts with sprinting and other animations.

According to recent reports, the end result should be faster attack speeds for the knife, and clearer wind-up animations for both the knife and the sledgehammer. The timing dictating when melee damage gets credited has also been made more consistent in different environments.

Recent findings suggest that interestingly, sprint is now only interrupted when the melee attack reaches its target. As it stands, sprinting is only interrupted after the full duration of the animation has been completed, which adds to the that perceived feeling of sluggishness.

The other major, and arguably most confusing is the nerf to jet cannons. The patch is going to make jets far less stronger against other air vehicles, requiring 40% more hits to destroy a target. This is puzzling because jets - and air vehicles in general - are already the least survivable in Battlefield 6.

And, considering how the rest of a jet's arsenal is either situational or nearly ineffective, the cannons were really the one guaranteed way of downing other air vehicles, so long as you manage to land your shots consistently. While the change is wellmeaning, the percentage will likely be reduced in future patches.

Industry observers note that finally, the update makes a few refinements to UI across the game, though mainly aimed at Redsec and modes where players wear armor. Armor bar visibility has been improved, and there’s a fix for the annoying bug that sometimes caused the armor bar to disappear every few seconds.

Read on below for the 1.1.3.5 change log.

Fnatic has confirmed the departure of its longest-serving player, jungler Razork, who is set to join Team Heretics. With support Lospa also set to leave, the London club faces a near-total LEC roster rebuild for 2027.

Fnatic has made its first confirmed exit official as it rebuilds its LEC roster for 2027. Razork was the London club’s longest-serving player and its main playmaker. He leaves after five seasons in the jungle.

The club marked the departure with a farewell video titled “Thank You, Iván”. In it, Fnatic recalls him arriving as a young player with huge ambition. He had entered the LEC with Misfits Gaming in 2020 before moving to Fnatic in 2022. The club later extended his contract to run through 2026.

In a recent development, his next stop appears to be Team Heretics. Sheep Esports reported that the 26-year-old will play alongside midlaner Jackies and support Jun. Heretics had already tried to sign him a year earlier. On that occasion it agreed a buyout with Fnatic but could not agree terms with the player.

The rebuild runs deeper than the jungle. Every Fnatic team member except Lospa was due out of contract in 2026. The support was signed until the end of 2027.

That deal will not keep him at Fnatic either. Lospa has reportedly agreed verbally to join SK Gaming for 2027. No buyout is involved in moving his contract between the two clubs. With that move, the one contract running beyond 2026 also leaves the club.

In the jungle, Yike is set to replace Razork in a 2027 line-up of Soboro, Yike, Vladi, Doggo and Labrov, according to Sheep Esports sources.

Sources indicate that the overhaul follows a difficult year. Fnatic finished eighth in LEC 2026 Versus. It then placed seventh in Spring, which ended on 10 May. Summer brought the same finishing position.

Recent findings suggest that A loss to GIANTX on 30 August kept the team out of the Summer playoffs. That defeat left the club absent from Worlds for the first time since 2016.

Famous Japanese game director and producer Katsuhiro Harada, known for the Bandai Namco series Tekken, has revealed a Pokémon he wanted to add to the Pokémon fighting game Pokken Tournament but it didn't make the cut.

Harada, who worked as a producer on both versions of the game, wanted the fighting / dark-type Pokémon 'Pangoro' from Generation VI. As for why he wanted to include it, Harada thought it had a "really cool" design and almost looked like it was wearing a traditional Japanese school uniform.

There were many discussions before finalising the roster, and a lot of it came down to the gameplay and systems in place, along with The Pokémon Firm's own requests. Here's what Harada had to say about this (via EventHubs):.

Harada: "We had thorough discussions before finalizing the roster. There were Pokémon that the development team wanted to include from a gameplay and systems perspective, and of course, The Pokémon Organization also had its own requests for which Pokémon they wanted to see in the game.".

After the release of Pokken Tournament DX for Switch, the final roster included the following Pokémon (this included some Switch-exclusive and DLC Pokémon).

According to recent reports, as you can see, the final roster is an interesting mix. Harada, who is now the CEO and game director of SNK's VS Studio, added how he was just personally happy at the time to see the lineup include Pikachu and Gengar.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • An IBM quantum computer has completed an extraordinarily complex computational task in just 15 minutes, while leading methods for simulating the calculation on conventional computers would require prohibitively long runtimes.
  • Sources indicate that the achievement, led by IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago, satisfies the fundamental criteria for quantum advantage.
  • It has been revealed that in their newly introduced paper, "Sampling hard circuits with verifiably high fidelity," the researchers demonstrated that both objectives could be achieved simultaneously using a novel design for encoded quantum circuits.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

An IBM quantum computer has completed an extraordinarily complex computational task in just 15 minutes, while leading methods for simulating the calculation on conventional computers would require prohibitively long runtimes. Perhaps even more significantly, researchers were able to establish statistical confidence in the accuracy of the quantum computer's results, addressing one of the biggest obstacles in the field.

Sources indicate that the achievement, led by IBM and researchers from the University of Chicago, satisfies the fundamental criteria for quantum advantage. This milestone occurs when a quantum computer performs a computational task beyond the practical capabilities of leading classical computing methods while producing results that can be trusted.

It has been revealed that in their newly introduced paper, "Sampling hard circuits with verifiably high fidelity," the researchers demonstrated that both objectives could be achieved simultaneously using a novel design for encoded quantum circuits. The experiment represents one of the largest demonstrations of logical quantum computing to date. The researchers have also made their circuits and experimental results publicly available through the Quantum Advantage Tracker.

Solving Quantum Computing's Verification Problem.

Sources indicate that unlike conventional computers, which process information using bits that represent either zero or one, quantum computers rely on quantum bits, or qubits. These can exist in combinations of both states and interact through a phenomenon known as quantum entanglement. These properties allow quantum computers to approach certain computational problems in fundamentally different ways.

For years, scientists have tested the capabilities of quantum computers using a benchmark called random circuit sampling (RCS). This technique involves running a series of randomly selected quantum operations and generating samples from a complex probability distribution. As the circuits grow larger and more complicated, reproducing their output with a classical computer becomes increasingly difficult.

Sources indicate that however, this approach creates a fundamental dilemma. If a computation is too difficult for a classical computer to reproduce, how can researchers establish that the quantum computer performed it correctly?

As computational complexity increases, independently verifying the results becomes progressively more difficult and eventually impractical without making strong assumptions about how accurately the quantum hardware operates.

To overcome this problem, the IBM and University of Chicago team developed a more structured alternative to random circuit sampling. The researchers mathematically demonstrated that their approach preserves the same computational hardness criteria as conventional RCS while introducing a structure that allows errors to be detected during the computation.

According to recent reports, "Verification remains one of the biggest challenges in firmly establishing experimental quantum advantage," mentioned Bill Fefferman, Associate Professor at the University of Chicago. "This experiment develops techniques to better characterize the fidelity of hard quantum states under noise, increasing confidence that the quantum computer is solving a computationally hard problem.".

Soumik Ghosh, PhD student in Fefferman's group at the University of Chicago, added, "Beyond strengthening experimental validation, advances in verification have the potential to unlock practical applications for the next generation of quantum computers.".

70 Logical Qubits and Tenfold Lower Error Rates.

Sources indicate that one of the greatest challenges in building powerful quantum computers is their extraordinary sensitivity to errors. Quantum information can be disrupted by environmental disturbances, imperfections in hardware, and inaccuracies in the operations used to manipulate qubits. As computations become longer and more complex, these errors can accumulate and undermine the reliability of the results.

In a recent development, quantum error correction addresses this weakness by encoding quantum information across multiple physical qubits to create more reliable units known as logical qubits. This approach allows certain errors to be identified and, depending on the technique, corrected or accounted for without destroying the underlying quantum information.

In one of the largest known demonstrations of quantum error correction, the researchers performed computations using 70 protected logical qubits. The experiment involved 2,415 logical two-qubit operations and 468 logical "T gates.".

Sources indicate that quantum gates are the fundamental operations that manipulate quantum information, much like logic gates in conventional computers. Two-qubit gates allow qubits to interact, while T gates enable additional types of quantum operations needed for universal quantum computing. Together, these gate counts illustrate the considerable complexity of the experiment.

By encoding the quantum circuits, the researchers achieved effective logical error rates 10 times lower than the underlying physical error rates. This substantial reduction allowed the quantum computer to maintain remarkably high fidelity, a measure of how closely the actual quantum state matches the intended one, despite performing thousands of complex operations.

"We are now firmly in the quantum advantage era," remarked Jay Gambetta, Director of IBM Research and IBM Fellow. "We have demonstrated a quantum computation beyond the practical reach of classical computers that establishes, with statistical confidence, a lower bound on how faithfully it was executed. This milestone gives scientists, developers, and businesses a latest foundation for trusting quantum computers as they scale to problems far beyond what we can achieve classically.".

The researchers found that many leading classical simulation techniques would require impractically long periods to reproduce the computation. IBM's quantum computer, by comparison, accomplished the task in approximately 15 minutes.

Although the experiment was designed to demonstrate quantum advantage rather than solve an immediate real-world problem, it addresses two essential requirements for making large-scale quantum computing practical: controlling errors and establishing confidence in computational results.

By demonstrating both capabilities in a computation beyond the practical reach of leading classical methods, the researchers have taken a significant step toward a future in which quantum computers could reliably tackle scientific and industrial problems that are right now out of reach.

How to find and install Netflix Games If you don't have it already, go ahead and download the Netflix app on your device. Keep in mind that you need to have an active Netflix subscription for this.

Now, let's get on with the list of best Netflix games at the moment.

Industry observers note that if you don't know anything about the Football Manager franchise, you must be either living under a rock or you just don't like football. But if you do like football and simulation games, then this is a no-brainer.

Become a club manager and take everything under your control, from tactics and transfers to team talks, scouting, and pretty much anything else that you can imagine.

You can start your career at any club in the world, as it supports every league and has real players. As I remarked, this game is a must if you are looking for a football simulation experience.

Download now! Football Manager 26 Mobile.

You already know about Bloons TD 6 from our previous articles, such as Bloons TD 6 tier list and best towers to carry your rounds. In this Netflix game, you benefit from hundreds of configurations and upgrades, so feel free to read all the guides we've created to help you on that journey.

Aside from that, what you need to know about this game is that it's wild. You have a tower defence type of game where things get increasingly more difficult. Towards the last levels, some players even reported crashes because of how crazy the battles turned out.

It's one of the most fun and entertaining tower defence games out there, and easily one of the best games Netflix has to offer.

Sources indicate that download now! Bloons TD 6 (Netflix).

Oxenfree is a story-driven adventure game with elements of mystery and suspense, sprinkled with paranormal elements.

The story follows a group of teenagers as they face the repercussions of opening a ghostly portal on an abandoned island, while out partying one night. It's also got a smart chat system that lets players have a major impact on the tale's action and conclusion.

Newly introduced graphics, a remixed soundtrack, a new epilogue, mysteries, and branching story paths can all be found in Oxenfree: Netflix Edition, which was published on September 24th, 2022. If you are interested in this title, here's a link to our full review of Oxenfree, where we get into specifics.

It has been revealed that before Your Eyes is a game with a major focus on storytelling and beauty. The actual story is a little dark at its core, but the way it is presented is far from it.

According to recent reports, it gives players the opportunity to immerse themselves in an individual's life, as they journey across the River Styx and into the afterlife. That is as dark as it appears, but it has its beauty.

Industry observers note that before Your Eyes has innovative gameplay with real-time tracking of the player's eye movements and blinking to make choices that impact the outcome of the story. It's not something we typically see in your run-of-the-mill mobile game.

According to recent reports, download now! Before Your Eyes.

Industry observers note that krispee Street is an adorably designed hidden object game that is exclusively accessible to Netflix members. This title draws inspiration from a well-known webcomic, and its graphics don't shy away from showing that. It's really well done.

Industry observers note that as a player, you'll have to figure out puzzles and discover well-hidden objects, and while it might sound like a piece of cake at first, it really isn't. Oh, and it also has a certain narrative that it manages to tell between the puzzles and hidden object games. It's really good, and a nice break from the classical, realistic hidden object game we're used to.

As a kid, you've probably dreamed of defending the Earth from various calamities or invasions and being a hero in the end. Well, Into the Breach will make your childhood dream finally come true. You're the last line of defence against the overgrown bug-like aliens that can crush a building without much effort. However, humanity has advanced, and we have huge mechs and other weapons of destruction because we humans are great at finding the best way to kill each other.

Fighting is done on an 8x8 grid that's similar to chess, with turn-based combat. As terrain can shift and create huge holes in the ground, it can be tricky to avoid them while facing aliens. Therefore, careful planning is essential to win every round, no matter what the end goal is. That's the only way to turn terrain shifts to your advantage, as gravity works on your adversaries as well.

Storyteller is a hit game unlike any other. It starts off pretty slow, with just a couple of prompts, but soon enough you will find yourself in a story unlike any other. The game is available on Steam as well, which is where it was first popularised.

Sources indicate that the best part about Storyteller is not the fact that it's sort of a build-your-own-story kind of game, but rather its unique take on it. You will be in charge of making a plot for each prompt you're given, and sometimes these plots have a twist. Literally. It's one of the best Netflix games ever released, and you shouldn't skip it.

Red Dead Redemption likely needs no introduction, though we should take a moment to appreciate how far mobile has come before we get to that. The fact that we can now carry an incredibly complex and detailed open-world shooter like this in our pockets indicates the leaps in technology since the game first released way back in 2010.

If you're somehow unfamiliar, it takes place in the Wild West and follows John Marston as he hunts down the surviving members of his old gang. Why? The federal government has taken his family and won't give them back until the job is done. Yeah, it's pretty heavy stuff and is a wonderfully told story. In some ways, I'd argue, it's better than its successor, Red Dead 2. I appreciate that’s a contentious statement, of course.

Recent findings suggest that but it's not all gloomy stuff. Thanks to the open-world nature of it all, there's plenty of twisted fun to be had with tying people to train tracks and waiting for the next locomotive to roll through. Or if you don’t want to act like a Looney Tunes villain, you can swagger into a saloon, find a comfortable corner, and play poker for hours instead. It’s good fun either way.

Download now! Red Dead Redemption NETFLIX.

Death might not be the happiest topic in the world, but that doesn't mean it can't provide some level of catharsis when handled well. Spiritfarer takes this complex life event and somehow manages to turn it into a cosy management RPG.

You play as a ferrymaster tasked with guiding the recently passed to the afterlife. It's not a simple case of starting the engines and sailing across to the other side, though. The spirits you encounter are somewhat restless, and you'll need to care for them as they make their final voyage. That means getting to know them and their needs, which makes for an incredibly emotional final goodbye. Still, it's that bittersweet variety of sadness where you'll be pleased you took the plunge.

In a recent development, aside from chatting to Spiritfarer's lovable cast, you'll also busy yourself with fishing, crafting, mining, farming, and all manner of other things. Just because your destination is a fairly morbid one, it doesn't mean that everyday tasks can fall by the wayside, you see. They're still key and in many ways key to the relaxing vibe Spiritfarer offers.

Sources indicate that I've had fairly mixed opinions about Black Mirror ever since it jumped to Netflix. Though there have been plenty of good episodes since that move (Hi, San Junipero), I mostly find the quality has dipped (What was that awful werewolf episode all about?). However, Season 6's Plaything does stand out as one of the better offerings from the later series.

Now, that could simply be because my opinion is swayed by the video game stuff or the fantastic performance from Peter Capaldi (The best Doctor Who since the show's revival. Sorry, David). But either way, the fictional video game featured in it isn't actually fictional. Sort of. That's right, you can actually play Thronglets! It's just these little critters don't proposal to kill us all... I think.

According to recent reports, inspired by Black Mirror mastermind Charlie Brooker's obsession with keeping a Tamagotchi alive in his youth, Thronglets is a virtual pet sim that tasks you with helping the Throng thrive. They'll hatch from eggs before relying on you for food and entertainment. Do all those things, and you'll have an adorable little army (?). Just don't set them all on fire, alright? They don't take too kindly to that.
